omission.chore: Reduce reliance on a single hosting provider to lower single-point-of-failure risk.
omission.evidenceQuote: The design goal from the beginning was to prepare a tool with minimized risk of single point of failure and independent from single hosting.
omission.reason: The discussion explicitly states a hosting-resilience goal. The batch policy accepts a concrete business idea as its demand signal, so requiring an external customer request does not justify excluding it without scoring.
